description: Responsive image sizes for a website in one go (WebP and JPEG by default, AVIF or PNG too), into a folder per image, with a ready <picture>/srcset HTML snippet (also saved as snippet.html). Widths larger than an image are skipped, so nothing is enlarged. [Pro tool.]

alt.description: Alt text for the . Default: made from the file name.

files.description: Image files or folders (a folder means the images in it). ~ is your home folder.

formats.description: Formats to make. The last of JPEG/PNG is the fallback ; WebP and AVIF become lines.

output_dir.description: Where to put the folder of each image. Default: next to the original.

url_prefix.description: The folder the files will live in on the site, used in the snippet’s paths.

widths.description: Widths in pixels. Ones wider than the image are left out (the image’s own width is added as the top size instead).

name: make_web_image_set
title: Make a web image set
